The '''Security Squad''' was a division of [[the Young]] led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The Squad performed a house-by-house sweep of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zehava]] to retrieve any weapons not turned over by [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] citizens while tensions were still near a boiling point.
